storageAuthenticatedPolicies.name: bellows_capture_operator_insert
storageAuthenticatedPolicies.withCheck:
((bucket_id = 'bellows-capture'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM tongs.bellows_session_participants participant
  WHERE ((participant.session_id = (storage.foldername(objects.name))[2]) AND (participant.id = (storage.foldername(objects.name))[3]) AND (participant.user_id = auth.uid())))))

storageAuthenticatedPolicies.using:
((bucket_id = 'bellows-capture'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM tongs.bellows_sessions s
  WHERE ((s.id = (storage.foldername(objects.name))[2]) AND tongs.can_access_workspace(s.workspace_id)))))

storageAuthenticatedPolicies.name: brand_asset_objects_insert
storageAuthenticatedPolicies.withCheck:
((bucket_id = 'forge-workpieces'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM tongs.brand_asset_revisions revision
  WHERE ((revision.storage_bucket = objects.bucket_id) AND (revision.storage_key = objects.name) AND (revision.state = 'pending'::text) AND (revision.created_by = auth.uid()) AND tongs.has_workspace_role(revision.workspace_id, 'editor'::text)))))
